title: Filipino Sisig Ham Bites
description: A fusion twist on the classic Filipino sisig dish, combining crispy ham with spicy serrano peppers and tangy jam.

ingredients.name: Juicy lumpia wrapper (or any spring roll wrapper)

instructions: 1. Cut the lumpia wrapper into quarters.
2. In a mixing bowl, combine the diced ham, Serrano peppers, and jammed fruit.
3. Lay a quarter of the lumpia wrapper on a flat surface.
4. Place about 1 tablespoon of the ham mixture in the center of the wrapper.
5. Brush the edges of the wrapper with a little water.
6. Fold the bottom half of the wrapper over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up to form a tight cylinder.
8. Heat a non-stick pan or deep fryer with about 1/4 cup of vegetable oil over medium heat.
9. When the oil is hot, add a few of the ham bites and fry until golden brown and crispy.
10. Drain the fried bites on paper towels and serve hot.
